items.statement: The investigation independently generates and discriminates conformers for both public molecules, retains candidate identity and provenance, validates optimization/convergence, and reports stopping or bounded coverage.
items.expected: Candidate-level validation and coverage evidence is supplied without relying on an undisclosed paper route.

items.statement: The preferred AL structure is compact/folded with terminal groups close together.
items.expected: The selected AL candidate is a validated compact/folded structure under a stated descriptor.

items.statement: The preferred AB structure is open/extended with terminal groups separated by the longer chain.
items.expected: The selected AB candidate is a validated open/extended structure under a stated descriptor.

items.statement: The preferred extended AB structure has a larger dipole moment than preferred AL.
items.expected: The selected-candidate dipoles support AB > AL.
